correctness.rationale: The Schatten-four identity is (sum squared moduli)^2 minus twice the squared determinant. The adverse complex phase and off-diagonal balancing reduce the triangular mask to a two-real-variable quartic ratio. Eliminating the killed diagonal gives the unique positive stationary t satisfying t^3+4t^2+3t-1=0; independent symbolic differentiation gave -4(3t+2)(t^3+4t^2+3t-1)/[(1+t)^5(t^2+4t+2)^2], so the critical point is the maximum and endpoints give the lower ratio. The sharp norm is 1.037541006105634...; the explicit matrix attains it. An arbitrary 0/1 mask either contains a row-column-permuted triangular 2x2 compression or is disjoint rectangular all-ones blocks; in the latter case block-diagonal conditional expectation is contractive on S4. Finite-to-countable passage uses Schatten finite-section density; neither finite enumeration nor random tests alone establish the general assertion.
residual_risks: Only ordinary S4, complex scalar matrices, countable coordinate index; no p !=4 or cb-norm theorem.
